title: Pinning in non-critical half-space geometric last passage percolation
summary: We study a symmetrized (half-space) version of geometric last passage percolation with a boundary parameter $c$ that interpolates between subcritical, critical, and supercritical behavior. This model gives rise to a family of interlacing random curves, or a line ensemble, which encode both the usual last passage time and its higher-rank analogues. Although these ensembles are understood in most space-time regions, their behavior near the diagonal -- where the boundary effects are strongest -- has remained unclear outside the critical regime.
